title: aeschynanthus angustissimus
intro: Aeschynanthus angustissimus, commonly known as the 'Goldfish Plant', is a species of flowering plant in the Gesneriad family. It is a type of epiphytic plant that is native to Borneo and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aeschynanthus angustissimus include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids and phenolic compounds that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
